digest.component_or_area: CLI read support / store usability validation
propositions: CLI read handlers _cmd_list and _cmd_session_logs gate initialization on bare os.path.isdir(tracker) instead of store_is_usable, causing present-but-unusable stores (marker-files-only or mid-clone with unresolvable HEAD) to incorrectly return [] at exit 0 instead of rejecting with rc 1

rapt-dreadable-dromedary hardened the library read chokepoint _reads._tracker to use store_is_usable, creating an invariant that in-process reads must reject present-but-unusable stores, but CLI consumers were never updated

Replace bare os.path.isdir(tracker) gates at reads_cli.py:340 and :384 with store_is_usable(tracker) to restore parity with library behavior for broken/mid-clone stores while preserving absent-store and valid-empty-store contract
Present-but-unusable stores (no .git or .git with unresolvable HEAD and no store structure) must flip from rc 0 with [] output to rc 1 with not-initialized error message
Absent stores remain rc 1, valid empty stores remain rc 0 with [], and .git-less structured snapshots continue to read normally
